question: At which astrological and lunar times is the prescribed observance especially indicated?
premises: The times Libra and Capricorn are named.
The bright eighth lunar day is named.
These times are addressed to the goddess.
inference: The observance is indicated in Libra, in Capricorn, and on the bright eighth day.
plain_english: O lovely one, in Libra and in Capricorn, and on the bright eighth day.
